notes: ACS (Action Code Script, ACC/BCC/GDCC) has no classes, so class_start is 0 (rule None). Functions are numbered `script N (int x)` units (the issue-5782 language note): probes are scripts 2..13, the entry is script 1, and scripts reach each other by number through ACS_Execute, so the entry's calls_out_to is [ACS_Execute] rather than the probe names. Rules that are None in the registry and so plant expected 0 (n/a, see the ledger): high_risk_execution (no process/shell/eval facility in the sandboxed VM), safety_bypasses (no escape hatch), telemetry, test (no test framework), doc (no documentation-comment convention). Probes 3, 5, 7, 8 and 12 therefore carry a comment naming the absence and a bare `terminate;` so the unit is not empty. io is GetCVar/SetCVar/ConsoleCommand call statements (3, no assignment so state_mutation stays 0); globals is the GameType()/PlayerCount() accessors (2), not `global int` declarations; safety is Min()/Max() (2); cleanup is Thing_Remove()/Thing_Destroy() (2); state_mutation is `int first = items; first = 1; first += 1;` (2: a typed declaration is not a write). api = scripts, 3/3/3/4, and api_orphan_credit 0 in a/b/c because the api rule already counts every script (same as zig, ledger api-declared-orphans-are-not-new-surface). units_public equals the script count: engine marks a script public. Branch 3 in main = if, else, switch; `terminate`/`restart` are structural_boundaries, not branch. No string decoy: the danger-only string decoy needs a danger keyword the language's own rule can match and acs has no such rule (high_risk_execution None); see ledger entry string-decoy-unplantable-no-danger-rule. Engine gap found while authoring (not planted around): a QUOTED-NAME script (`script "probeBranch" (int x)`) is counted by func_start/args/api but produces no function unit (function_data empty for the file, units_public 0), so the shell uses numbered scripts as the issue's language note prescribes; the named-script form is a sibling gap on the engine side.
